visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-06-30
Patient: 45-year-old woman, established patient.
Chief complaint: follow-up after sleep study
Initial evaluation 2026-05-11: loud snoring, witnessed pauses in breathing, daytime sleepiness.
Sleep study 2026-05-28: positive for obstructive sleep apnea.
Plan: start positive airway pressure therapy; device ordered today.
Signed: treating clinician. 2026-06-30.

missing_evidence: sleep study report showing the apnea-hypopnea index
expected.rationale: The note says the study was positive but gives no index, and the policy turns on the number. The report itself is not in the file and has to be obtained from the sleep laboratory.
